title: POST /api/scan-tags, PUT /api/scan-tags/{tag_id} (request)
description: Create (POST, tag_id optional: missing = the hub draws a new id; given = an already written tag is registered in this hub) or change (PUT, tag_id not allowed) a tag. 409 tag_exists, 422 tag_limit (100), 422 invalid_target (entity unknown, domain does not fit the action, area unknown). Audit scan_tag_created/changed/deleted.
